notes:
Lead: CTO (Ravi Menon) + Head of Search (Laura Chen). Product: mid-market knowledge base & in-app help, multi-tenant SaaS for customer success teams. Current infra: AWS (us-east-1), Postgres + Elastic for metadata, batch ETL in Airflow. They ingest 3M docs (mixed html/pdf) annually; cold indexing window nightly, incremental updates throughout day. Evaluating embeddings pipeline: want to move from proprietary sparse approach to dense vectors for semantic search.

What they care about:
- Throughput: need 8000 embedding ops / hour peak; batch jobs of 200k docs (nightly) must finish within maintenance window (3-4 hours).
- Latency: interactive search acceptable <150ms for top-k retrieval; re-ranking budget ~200ms per query.
- Cost sensitivity: mid (want 30-50% cost improvement vs current SaaS vector provider).
- Integration: must work with Pinecone today, but open to Redwood's managed vector storage or connectors; require connector docs and sample Airflow operators.
- Security: strict SSO + SCIM, audit logs retention 1 year, KMS key control, data residency for EU customers.
